On the bottom, a new menu shows register for a business account Then you have to click on register Now you have to fill your business name Fill your business name you need to enter your business type If you are a manufacturer retailer, wholesaler you have to enter your business type Now fill up the business address filling in the correct Business Type filling in the Business Address Click on checkbox to accept the user agreement Before accepting the user agreement you must read the checkbox and the PensaPay user is required to be accepted. so, this is the payment gateway service provided in ebay here you will have to click on the checkbox to accept PensaPay User Agreement and then go ahead then you see a page opening Click continue. After that, you need to enter your mobile number in the ebay user ID and password. Click continue button as per your preference. Click E-mail to add a confirmation code with you ebay account number you wanna enter. Click continue button to continue. Mail will come to you from ebay and your mobile number click continue button You will get mail from ebay to complete registration process now you have to do next step to register on money on right side you have to click on MyPasaPay You have to click and register on money you can purchase you will see the section under the wallet you can get it here here this is my money aswell you will come here you to get it so these are some basic information now just click on deposit see here this is my money on my wallet you are getting the second option, which is brought with PaesaPay if you are purchasing via PaesaPay, you'll get the second option In this section brought with PaesaPay when you want to register again, you need to click on a link to register with PaesaPay Then you need to log into the PaesaPay, registration page The form for registration of PaesaPay isay account, fill in all the information about your business name, any account type and then select the bank account, enter your PAN number and team number, for that check the checkbox. and then you need to fill PAN & TIN number If you want to fill TIN number then you need to select in check box that TIN is NOT APPLICABLE then next you have to fill Bank information then you have to select here then you should review once if the information given is correct or not Now you can enter the correct information You can edit the previous information Tap on Register Account and Continue You will come an update from the PasaPlay Request Now you can see the message is there as successful completion of PASAPAY registration. And, you have completed registration for PASAPAY. Now, you can see that quite an amount of information is available here. So what information is available here? You can visit the Seller Centre on eBay, where you will buy many other products for sale. Then here if you have not submitted documents like PAN, TIN numbers, etc. then, you have to upload them with your payment documents. And here it's written that, Upload Your Payasapay Residuals and KYC Documents, After you click on the link, click on Upload. FDF. FDF facility charges in cash. FDF will be used for total product fees and FDF facility charges. 5. Insertion fees. if you list products, new policies have just shown on the ebay, you can only upload 50 products and give 30% discount. 6. If you only list 50 products like for a new seller you can list 25 products on eBay. Now, eBay policy is very strict and only because you can apply for listing limitation. Now what is the fees of Insuranc. If your product is Unisex and you do you want to sell that particular product in two categories men and women? Then you can do that, but you have to pay a fee. They take 2 rupees per category per listing If you want unlimited listing validity then also you have to pay EVAY fee per month otherwise you can list your product for 7 days, 10 days or 30 days If you want to remove listing validity pay one fee to ebay these are the fees you have to pay check the final chart the final value fee is charged only if the product sales 1% to 10% depends on the product category Fiscalite charges and fees are 10 % as per your category and facility charges on FISA varies from 4.5 % to 8 % it depends on the category and if you want to give warranty it is dependent on the warranty period so facility charges on FISA are similar to closing fees and fix fees in other brands in eBay Like other market, in which you have to get a fixed closing fee, the same is applied here. On ebay, you must deliver the first 30 orders by yourself. Now as I said, you cannot activate power shift when not delivering 30 orders. Now check the power shift visit ebay.in for the latest update here i will give you an overview all your fees and shipping fee you can check this after your powership is activated and here PS-Activation see powership is currently available you can see 30 orders for ebay products are currently enabled i received 30 orders for 30 days then you can activate the PowerShip You have to click here If you have any question, please do ask us by commenting. if you like this video, then please do not forget to press like button. now if you are new to this channel, do subscribe to the YouTube channel. now, we will meet in the next video.
